title: Lower ME: Front Squat + Pull
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: KOT Sissy Squat × 8 · Wall Shoulder CAR × 3/side · CL Dead Bug × 6/side
jumps: Front Squat 3 · 5-sec lower @ RPE 7.5 → Hurdle Hops 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Eccentric wk 2: heavier, 5 sec down · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · every jump max intent · elbows high · no hurdles? Tuck jumps
Side to side over a line
strength: Band or Banded Lat Pulldown to scale · rest 2:00

cond.subtitle: Cap 12 min
items: Cal Assault bike (or 2× the reps as walking lunge steps)

note: Happy Thanksgiving. Get your training in early, then go eat. Eccentric wk 2: more weight on the bar, 5-second lowering. Write down your heavy-step weight.
